column3: Ah, the man behind the curtain!
As I live and breathe.
I was starting to think you were just a disembodied limb with anger issues!
Yeah, well I'm sorry to disappoint you.
Just tell me, how'd you figure out the five-fingered handshake of formality?
Good evening, kid.
Having a good time, sir?
Oh dear, now there's another one!
Go and sober up on the sofa, Mr Ackerman.
Hey there.
Greetings.
I'm Brother Jared, Custodian of the Silken Palms.
How can I be of assistance?
I see.
*sigh* Yes, very good.
Mm-hmm.
Salutations!
I'm Sister Gretchen, chief officer of the itinerary!
Your payment, surely you had something agreed in writing?
Alas, our arrangement was but a delicate dance of words.
You only had a verbal agreement?
Oui, but Lady Unterwald is no longer here to keep her word.
Never again, Monsieur.
Did you see anything suspicious during the speech?
As you know, I capture every detail in the frame, just as I see it.
But the lights went out moments before we went through that tunnel.
When we emerged, all I could see was that look of terror, frozen on her face.
You didn't see anybody get close to Lady Unterwald?
If somebody approached Lady Unterwald with a weapon, I would have captured it.
I assure you, nobody moves faster than I can speed paint!
Who do you think would want to harm Lady Unterwald?
Isn't it obvious? A rival artist, surely consumed by jealousy.
They would stop at nothing to ruin my livelihood!
Someone's been threatening you?
Well, no. But it's a chilling thought!
Won't you have to find yourself a new muse?
First things first. Much like the greats before me, I shall channel my suffering into art.
Only then can I begin the arduous task of finding myself a new muse.
There is something I'd like you to help me with.
Ahh, what is it that you wish to capture? The human condition?
I'll need to be paid in advance, and no, I don't work for exposure.
I can't afford to make that mistake again.
This commission, what would you take as payment?
I'll need an upfront cash payment. No cheques, IOU's or other empty promises.
Take care of yourself.
I bid you adieu.
Sorry, can't tell you. It's a secret.
Funny guy, thinking you can keep secrets from a secret society.
That's hilarious stuff.
You have to admit, it's a little funny.
I just asked around, it seemed pretty easy to pick up!
I don't believe it for a second. You've been talking to that blabbering Doctor, haven't you?
I'm afraid I can't say.
Ugh! What part of ‘secret handshake' does that guy not get?
The secret part, I assume.
Just a little something I like to call intuition.
Mm-hmm. I doubt that very much.
I paid the world's fastest painter to capture your moves!
Pfft, come on. Nobody is that fast!
So, what does The Order of Idle Hands actually do?
The order was set up as a secret committee of sorts. We worked to ensure Lady Unterwald's business affairs were smoothly orchestrated behind the scenes.
And how's that going?
It hasn't been our finest hour.
What will you do about Lady Unterwald's murder?
It's probably best we don't meddle any further. Not until Lady Unterwald's last will and testament is in our hands.
I'm looking for the Doctor's medical briefcase.
Doctor Hirsch misplaced his bag, huh?
Any unattended luggage is usually thrown back into the storage room.
You'd need a key to get in there, though.
Do you have any ideas on opening a locked safe?
Hmm. Got any explosives to hand?
No, I didn't think to bring any with me.
Too bad. In that case, you're playing by the safe's rules.
So you want to know how I figured out the handshake?
Go on.
I should be going.
Come and find us as soon as you've recovered that will, Arthur.
Custodian of the Silken Palms?
Oh yes!
Did you know the hands are the most used part of the body?
Is that true?
I'm the first line of defence against wrinkles, cracking and dehydration.
It's a lot of responsibility!
What does the Custodian of the Silken Palms do, exactly?
Cuticle care, nail filing, the odd hand massage here and there.
I've even formulated my own hand cream, packed with essential oils. It's known to boost moisture levels and skin elasticity!
They're quite therapeutic, you know!
Moisturised any hands lately?
Why, were you looking to make an appointment?
I'm sure I could squeeze you in!
Ah, that won't be necessary.
Another time, then!
What's that book you're reading?
Oh, this? It's Dr Phogg's Guide to Invis-Ability!
The title is written in invisible ink, see?
Hm, I don't see!
Exactly. That's how you know it's the real deal!
The Order has its handshakes, but secret messages? Invisible ink?
This is going to elevate us to a whole new level!
What's the book you're reading called again?
I still don't see it.
Exactly. It's Dr Phogg's Guide to Invis-Ability!
Does your guide book explain how to reveal hidden messages?
Well sure, there's a whole chapter on it!
But no spoilers, okay? I haven't gotten to that part yet!
Can I borrow your copy of Dr Phogg's Guide to Invis-Ability?
No way, I'm not done with it yet.
How's the book going?
It's become quite melancholy, I'm not sure what to make of it.
A lot more rhyming, I imagine?
How did you know?
Just a hunch.
Have you seen the doctor's briefcase around?
Can't say that I have, sorry!
Do you think Mr Masson will be okay?
He'll be sporting a headache and a sizable bar tab to settle, but I'm fairly confident that he'll recover.
I should really get going.
Don't be a stranger!
What were you calling yourselves again?
The Order Of Idle Hands!
Since its inception, the order has gently nudged Lady Unterwald's business endeavours.
However, I must admit, tonight's events have caught us all off guard.
What are you doing about Lady Unterwald?
Our first order of business is to get that will and testament back.
Are you making any progress with the safe you discovered?
I'm still working on it!
Just let us know when you've got that safe open, and we'll take it from there!
Nice robes, did you make them yourselves?
They were sourced from a small, independent seller.
His mother, if you must know.
She's a wonderful seamstress!
Have you seen a medical briefcase around here?
Sorry Arthur, I'm afraid we've been a little distracted.
What with the murder and everything?
Yes, the murder. Thank you for reminding me.
What's with the gentleman on the sofa?
Doctor Hirsch brought him in this afternoon, it seems he went a bit overboard with the drinks.
Not to worry, though, Maurice is keeping an eye on him for us.
Isn't that right, Maurice?
Mm hm.
Any idea when he'll be back to his senses?
Judging by his current condition, I doubt it'll be any time soon.
I'll be going now.
Speak soon.
I'm afraid not, but I'll make a mental note!
If anyone comes across it, you'll be the first to know!
Any ideas on how to get Lady Unterwald's safe open?
That depends, what kind of locks are we working with?
The safe has two mechanisms. A combination lock and a voice-activated lock.
The combination sounds simple enough. It's likely a date or number sequence.
But a voice activated lock..
How's your Lady Unterwald impression?
Far from convincing, I'm afraid.
What's on the itinerary for today?
Oh, don't even get me started.
With the death of Lady Unterwald, my entire agenda just went up in smoke!
What an inconvenience!
I know! I'm going to have to start the whole thing from scratch.
How is the new itinerary coming along?
I'm still trying to formulate a new agenda.
So far I've written down ‘Recover the last will and testament of Lady Unterwald'
How are you doing on that end?
I'm still working on that.
Any updates on the itinerary?
Still just that one item, Mr Ackerman.
Are you any closer to recovering Lady Unterwald's will?
I'm working on it!
Is this level of secrecy really necessary?
Back when I first joined, a simple nod and a wink sufficed.
Then, we transitioned to the passwords.
After that it was the handshakes.
Now Brother Jared is researching invisible ink!
You can't stop the march of progression, Gretchen!
See you around!
Are you ready?
Ready!
Then let us begin!
Show me, exaltation!
What a big smile, beautiful!
Give me contemplation!
Ah, I can see you're thinking very hard!
For this next one, you're flabbergasted!
Oui, oui! You've never looked more confused!
Ah, pure perfection!
I feel rejuvenated, thank you, Arthur.
Don't mention it!
Pierre managed to capture the handshakes in the background of these sketches!
I should take them to Dr Hirsch and see what he can tell me.
Come back when you know what you're doing, kid.
Don't waste my time, kid.
Arthur Ackerman. We've been expecting you for some time.
You have?
Another newbie? Which one is this?
The uninitiated one.
The who?
You know, the dummy.
What's going on here?
Come forth, my child.
Take my hand, let us see what the future has in store for you.
You're going to read my palm?
One moment.
Ahh, yes, I see it now.
What do you see?
I see... a foul concoction. It will bring you closer to the truth.
Beware the doppelgänger, for they will be instrumental to your undoing.
Unaware to all, a dangerous secret has been hatched.
That which is lost must be found.
Three at odds must come together to break their chains.
Good fortune will come to you, but at a great price.
Fascinating! What does it all mean?
Honestly? I have no idea.
What? Well, what good is that?
Look, I'm trained to see the visions of the future.
The understanding part is a little trickier. I haven't mastered that yet.
Anyway, I suppose an introduction is in order.
Welcome to...
The what?
THE ORDER OF-
Yes, thank you Brother Jared.
We are The Order Of Idle Hands. The guiding hand of the Unterwald empire.
We exist to protect Lady Unterwald and her interests.
But, Lady Unterwald is dead.
Yes, well.. Things have admittedly gone a bit astray in the last few hours.
Look, there's no need to rub it in, is there?
Well, what are you going to do about it?
Look, we've all had a very productive meeting...
And?
And we feel that we should probably defer to Lady Unterwald's final wishes on this.
The best way to do that would be to get a look at her last will and testament.
You mean the one that her careless attorney lost?
Okay, now who's rubbing it in?
Now, now. I know tensions are high, but we need to keep our composure.
Perhaps you could provide a status report on your efforts, Arthur?
I'm still working to get the last will and testament back.
While I was looking, I discovered a hidden safe in Lady Unterwald's quarters.
Is that so?
I don't think we knew about that one, did we?
It's sealed shut, but with the right information I think we could get it open.
It's possible that Lady Unterwald kept a copy of her will inside that safe.
Oh, well that is good news!
That would certainly save us the headache of coming up with a better plan.
Indeed. I think that wraps things up quite neatly then?
What do you mean?
Alright, Arthur! Just let us know when you've got that safe open, and we'll take it from there!
Bu-
Excellent work!
Well, I don't know, do I? This is just the demo.
Oh, right.
UhHh ohH
It's a mouse burrow.
